**Problem**: The `getClassInfo(Set<ClassName>)` method was removed from `CoverageDatabase` interface in pitest 1.10.0.

1. **`src/main/java/org/pitest/elements/models/MutationTestSummaryData.java`**
   - Changed `Set<ClassInfo>` to `Set<ClassName>`
   - Updated constructor and getter to use `ClassName`
   - Updated `getPackageName()` to call `asJavaName()` directly (no longer need `.getName()`)

2. **`src/main/java/org/pitest/elements/MutationReportListener.java`**
   - Removed call to `coverage.getClassInfo()`, replaced with `Collections.singleton(data.getMutatedClass())`

3. **`src/main/java/org/pitest/elements/utils/JsonParser.java`**
   - Changed import from `ClassInfo` to `ClassName`
   - Updated methods to accept `Collection<ClassName>` instead of `Collection<ClassInfo>`
   - Simplified `classInfoToNames()` to use `ClassName::asJavaName` directly

4. **`src/test/java/org/pitest/elements/MutationHtmlReportListenerTest.java`**
   - Removed unused `ClassInfo` mock and import
   - Removed mock setup for `getClassInfo()` method

5. **`src/test/java/org/pitest/elements/utils/JsonParserTest.java`**
   - Removed `MockClassInfo` class that extended `ClassInfo` (now final)
   - Updated tests to use `ClassName.fromString()` instead of mock `ClassInfo`

6. **`src/test/java/org/pitest/elements/models/MutationTestSummaryDataTest.java`**
   - Changed from mocking `ClassInfo` to using `ClassName.fromString()`
   - Fixed test to use distinct class names to properly test Set deduplication
